data.name: lblFilterStatusUnavailable.Text
data.value:
The filter details are currently unavailable.
Make sure the service is started, check your remoting settings and try again.

data.name: txtListNotes.Text
data.value: The list settings enables/disables list groups, or individual lists. Use the quick add feature to quickly block a website or file.

data.name: lblRemotingSettingsError.Text
data.value: * The remoting server could not be found with the specified settings. Make sure the sift service is started on the target computer and try again.

data.name: lblRemotingSettingsNotes.Text
data.value: The remoting settings allows you to specify the computer you are administering. To connect to another computer running Sift, specify the computer name or IP and the username and password for that account.

data.name: lblAdapterNotes.Text
data.value: Set the default filter settings here. To override the settings, select the adapter you wish to customize and check 'Override default settings'.
